detail.longDescription: About Amazon, 11 Nov: AWS released AWS Emulator, a local emulator of AWS services under CC0. AWS says thousands of AI agents wrote all of it and its team has not reviewed the code. Known gaps are listed in the repo. My read: good for fast local tests, but it's a test double. Run your suite on it and on real AWS before trusting it. https://www. aboutamazon.com/news/aws/how-a utonomous-ai-agents-built-aws-emulator # AWS # DevOps # Testing
